purpose: A labelled set of independent checkboxes answering one question, with an optional footer for helper text or the error. Its size, placement, state and variant cascade to every row.

notFor.case: A single opt-in or terms checkbox.
Only one of the options may be chosen.
A list of settings that each apply immediately.
Choosing from a long, searchable list of options.

Invalid.meaning: The selection fails validation; the footer becomes the error.
Invalid.visual: Footer Status/critical/content; every row takes CheckboxItem Invalid.

Disabled.visual: Group label and footer Content/disabled; every row takes CheckboxItem Disabled.

a11y.role: group (aria-labelledby the group label, aria-describedby the footer)
a11y.keyboard: Each checkbox is its own tab stop; Space toggles the focused one (Radix Checkbox).
notes: Each checkbox stays independent; the group only names and describes them.

openQuestions: Motion: the State axis (Default · Invalid · Disabled) has no motion decision and recipes/motion.ts has no entry. Should the footer's switch to the error animate? (finding MOT-002 CheckboxGroup)
